content.text:
**Analyzing Grid Data**

I've been analyzing the 10x10 input grid, focusing on the lower half (rows 5-9) where the color 9 is found. I've calculated the column counts for each row: row 5 and 9 have two instances, row 6 and 8 have two, and row 7 has eight. The axis row will be the current row.


**Calculating Row Periodicity**

I've determined a periodicity of 4 based on the relationship between column values (c) and corresponding row displacements (dr) in the lower half. I've mapped the modulo 4 remainders of x (which is equivalent to c for the lower half) to the possible dr values. The upper half analysis mirrors this, using a formula 19 - c to relate the columns to row displacements. I'm now mapping the modulo 4 remainders of the new x value (19-c) in relation to the dr of the upper half.
